title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI gate with metric thresholds and quality gating
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: prevent accidental prompt-set regressions from rolling into production by adding an automated CI gate that evaluates candidate changes against a stable prompt-set and fail/pass based on configurable metric thresholds. This PR implements: 1) a new CI job (eval-harness/prompt-regression) that runs lightweight evals in CI using cached artifacts and sample seeds; 2) metric threshold config and a small threshold library that supports per-prompt and aggregate gates (accuracy, F1, ROUGE-L, and hallucination rate); 3) quality gating logic that produces a machine-readable artifact (regression-report.json) to be consumed by our merge bot; 4) docs and runbook for maintainers. Implementation notes: - CI job uses a fast subset of the existing eval-harness prompt sets (default.yaml -> ci_subset) and runs on a single S-size runner with cached model artifacts to keep runtime ~15-20m. - Thresholds are defined in eval-harness/checks/thresholds.py with an allowlist override for known flaky prompts. - Regression signal is computed per-prompt and aggregated using a weighted scoring heuristic (documented in docs/ci.md). - Added a fallback path that marks the gate as 'needs triage' instead of blocking when the eval run is inconclusive (timeouts / model infra errors). Backwards compatibility: existing nightly evals are unchanged. Checklist: - [x] implement CI job config and task wrapper - [x] add thresholds and evaluation logic - [x] wire artifact publishing for regression reports - [x] add docs and runbook - [x] add unit tests for threshold library - [x] smoke test on staging CI Results summary and guidance provided in the PR comments.

review_conversation: Samira Patel (reviewer): Can we reduce runtime by sampling fewer seeds for the quick CI run? Also request an explanation in the threshold module for how weighted aggregation is computed.
Asha Kapoor (author): Reduced seeds from 5->3 for CI subset and added inline docstring + unit tests that validate aggregation behavior.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): The allowlist looks fine but we should avoid long-term accumulation; added a suggestion to track allowlist changes in a Linear task.
Marta Ruiz (approver): Verified staging CI run and artifacts. Approving after lint+unit tests passed. Suggested follow-up: add historical dashboard to track gate pass/fail rates.
CI bot: integration-evals failed on first run (intermittent model download timeout), reran, subsequent run passed.
release_notes:
- Added prompt-regression CI gate to prevent prompt-set regressions
- New thresholds library for eval-harness (accuracy/F1/ROUGE-L/hallucination rate)
- Docs and runbook for maintaining CI gate
notes_for_maintainers: Gate runtime is ~15-20m on CI. If the eval infra is flaky, the gate will emit 'needs triage' to avoid blocking merges; triage run instructions are in docs/ci.md. Add new prompts to eval-harness/prompt_sets/ci_subset.yaml and update thresholds if introducing new task types.
changelog_summary: Introduce prompt-regression CI gate with metric thresholds and quality gating to prevent regressions to model/prompt changes.
